title: Dot product of flattened binary matrices
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $A,B$ be $n\times n$ matrices over $\bbr_2$. Flatten each matrix into a vector using the coordinate ordering of pairs of indices. The dot product of the flattened matrices equals $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}\sum_{j=0}^{n-1} A_{ij}B_{ij}$ in $\bbr_2$.
